project: POP PUNK GUITAR LIBRARY MANAGER ULTIMATE

profiles.source_location_note: Resolve the actual folder or archive on the user's PC at first local scan. Do not assume a path or that source audio is present in this repository.

plugin_mapping.purpose: Build source material candidates for POP PUNK GUITAR ULTIMATE factory presets and sub-presets.

output_policy.sample_rate_policy: Preserve source rate unless an explicitly approved conversion is required.

multi_resolution_extraction.strategy: Create linked candidate levels from each source; do not choose only one segmentation size.

levels.purpose: Extract coherent riffs, loops, progressions and multi-bar phrases.
Extract useful rhythmic passages, palm-mute patterns, strumming and chord-hit sequences.
Extract individual notes, chord hits, slides and harmonics when boundaries are reliable.
Detect attacks for analysis; do not publish automatically without review.

boundary_rules: Use onset detection as evidence, not as the sole segmentation rule.
Prefer musical boundaries, beat/bar alignment and phrase coherence when confidence supports them.
Preserve natural attack and decay; handle boundaries to avoid clicks.
Do not split a chord or sustained note in the middle merely because its waveform changes.
Do not split a coherent riff into isolated notes by default; retain both phrase and optional child events.
Keep uncertain boundaries as review candidates with confidence and editable start/end markers.
Detect repetitions and suggest representative takes while retaining meaningful performance variations.

output_policy.plugin_asset_rule: Each approved preset assignment points to a specific derived WAV clip or deliberately selected phrase/loop. The plugin must not play the full source recording unless explicitly selected as the asset.
